title: Leaderboard list endpoint coerces "viewed" status to Submitted — viewed apps render wrong pill
detail: GET /api/v1/vacancies/:id/applications (router.gleam:415) builds LeaderboardEntry here. With the new enum value, row.status can be "viewed"; this case lacks that arm, so the unknown fallback logs a warning and coerces it to Submitted. The client then renders a Submitted pill and status_rank 0 for a viewed applicant — the AC "leaderboard rows render viewed" is violated.
recommended_fix: Add `"viewed" -> application.Viewed` to the case in application_list_handler.gleam (between shortlisted and approved), matching parse_status and the shared codec.

title: ApiReturnedStatusUpdate optimistic update has no "viewed" arm — local model keeps stale status until refetch
evidence:
let updated_status = case new_status {
                "under_review" -> application.UnderReview
                "shortlisted" -> application.Shortlisted
                "approved" -> application.Approved
                "rejected" -> application.Rejected
                "auto_closed" -> application.AutoClosed
                _ -> app.status
              }
detail: After a PATCH to "viewed", the server returns {data:{status:"viewed"}} (data_status_decoder is a raw string), so new_status="viewed". This case has no viewed arm, so updated_status falls back to app.status (the old status). The batched refetch recovers it, but during that window the stepper shows the old status as current while focus jumps to the Viewed stop — inconsistent with every other status which has an explicit arm.
recommended_fix: Add `"viewed" -> application.Viewed` to the case in client.gleam's ApiReturnedStatusUpdate handler, mirroring the other statuses.
